key_idea: Process edges in order with a union-find and report the index of the edge that brings the component count down to 1.
sketch: Initialise DSU with N components; for each edge in input order union its endpoints and decrement the component count when they were in different sets; print the 1-based edge index the moment the count hits 1. Special case N=1: already connected with 0 edges. If the count never reaches 1 print -1. O((N+M) alpha) with path halving; use fast input for 1e6 edges.
